set.body: Found by the external consumer (bd-01M3ZRJ9ZCP8E7442J9VKC1Y6V): with the default point glyph (hollow circle) the SVG widget hits only the stroked ring; hovering or clicking a mark's centre does nothing. Picking.fromResolved uses PickPolicy default HollowPicking.Outline and SvgWidgetView.compile/SvgWidget expose no way to choose HollowPicking.Inside. Every widget fixture check hovers the navigation anchor (on the ring), so no browser check sees it. Probe: consumer page, circle 12 centre: no HoverChanged; ring hits do. Decide and implement: (a) expose PickPolicy (or HollowPicking) on SvgWidgetView.compile / WidgetOptions, applied identically on Canvas; (b) whether the widget default for point glyphs should be Inside (ggiraph/SVG users expect a point's disc to be hittable; ggplot's default point is solid). Acceptance: browser check hovering a hollow point's centre under the chosen default and under each explicit policy; JavaFX host same policy; docs.
set.title: [Intaglio] Browser widgets cannot pick the inside of hollow point glyphs
